title: Digi International Joins T-Mobile Partner Plus Channel Subsidy Program
summary: IoT leader delivers affordable, high-performance solutions for wireless networking as Digi EX50 5G, TX40 5G, and IX40 5G cellular routers are made available at T-Mobile Partner Plus MSRP
